title: GenerationJob
description: One unit of GPU work tracked by the Render Orchestrator's GenerationPipeline: submitting a single RenderSpec to a chosen IVideoEngine/IComputeProvider pair and following it to completion or failure.

external_job_id.description: The IComputeProvider's own job id (e.g. a RunPod job id), once submitted.

output_asset_id.description: Set on completion - the asset_id AssetManager registered the resulting RawClip under.

error_message.description: Set on failure - the last error, after all retries were exhausted.
